thread:
alertbot: PROD alert — tool-invocations 4xx rate spike on /v1/call-tool, error rate 5m 2.1% -> 8.9% :rotating_light:

support_jay: 💬 multiple customer tickets opened about 400s: 'tool_schema_error' when attempting tool calls. Raising to incidents channel. @eng_maya can you take a look?

eng_maya: looking now. do we have any sample requests from a customer?

support_jay: pasted one from Acme SRE below (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/call-tool
{
  "tool": "contact_lookup",
  "args": "{\"email\": \"bob@example.com\", \"scope\": [\"work\"]}",
  "meta": { "client": "acme-integration", "version": "1.2.0" }
}
```

support_jay: response: 400 {"error":"tool_schema_error","message":"args must be JSON object, got string"}

eng_maya: aha — args are being passed as a string instead of an object. that's not new code on the SDK side AFAIK. checking ingress logs for accepts vs rejects.

oncall_ryan: FYI we had a runtime deploy ~35m ago to the tool-router service: `tool-router@v2.7.1` (deploy-bot below).

deploy-bot: deploy completed: tool-router v2.7.1 by eng_platform CI at 1769450000 — rollout 100% in prod.

eng_maya: can someone grep logs for tool-router rejecting payloads with "args must be JSON object"? suspect a stricter JSON schema validation shipped in v2.7.1.

eng-platform: running quick query on logs: `service:tool-router AND message:"args must be JSON object"` -> spike starting 1769449800 matching the deploy window. counts: 5m window 03:10 -> 120 errors, previous 5m window 12 errors.

eng_maya: OK that matches. two possible vectors: (A) strict validator change in tool-router or (B) upstream SDK started serializing args as string. we need repro. support_jay can you ask Acme for the exact SDK and client call? also paste headers (content-type) if available.

support_jay: asked Acme. they replied: Node SDK 1.2.0, call: `client.callTool({tool: 'contact_lookup', args: JSON.stringify({email, scope: ['work']})})` — they said they used to do that and it worked before. headers: `content-type: application/json`

eng_maya: JSON.stringify(args) would have worked before if router accepted stringified args. Looks like v2.7.1 now enforces args type to be object. This is a breaking validator change.

oncall_ryan: impact: affects integrations that stringified args (we saw >15 customers). severity: P2 but customer-facing. recommendation: rollback tool-router to v2.7.0 or patch validator to accept strings and parse them.

eng-platform: can do quick feature-flag to enable permissive-args parsing. ops-flag endpoint: `POST /ops/flags/tool-router/permissive_args true`

eng_maya: I'll push the flag. will monitor error rate.

eng_maya: running: `curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/flags -d '{"flag":"tool-router.permissive_args","value":true}'`

eng-platform: flag applied across prod edge in ~20s.

alertbot: metric update: tool-invocations 4xx rate dropped from 8.9% -> 2.3% in 3m after flag toggle.

cust_acme_sre: confirmed — our calls are succeeding again. thanks for the fast turnaround. :tada:

eng_maya: great. plan: (1) open PR to revert the strict validator in tool-router (or make it opt-in), (2) patch for backwards compat to accept stringified args, (3) add integration test for SDK behavior, (4) coordinate SDK release notes.

support_jay: logging a customer outreach task for the affected customers and advising a migration path (stop stringifying args).

oncall_ryan: created incident ticket in JIRA: INF-4321, assigned to eng-runtime, priority P2. Please add timeline + postmortem once done.

eng_maya: thanks all. marking this thread resolved for now, reopening if rates creep back up.

support_jay: note for postmortem: include repro steps — sample client call with JSON.stringify(args), example router validation failure, metric graphs, deploy id v2.7.1, flag toggle timeline.

alertbot: closing alert — currently within baseline.
